title: Quietly Silky Middle Eastern Lentils Mujadara
description: A winey, silky Middle Eastern dish featuring mature cheddar and al-dente finish lentils, perfect for a date night. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly recipe is made in a tava-griddle.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tava-griddle over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cumin, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the red wine and bring to a simmer.
Add the lentils and 2 cups of water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are al-dente.
Add the uncooked basmati rice to the tava-griddle, and stir to combine with the lentil mixture.
Cover and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the shredded mature cheddar cheese until it is melted and well combined.
Serve the Quietly Silky Middle Eastern Lentils Mujadara hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
